region: 35knots.com. Spots marked "verboden" by the NKV are left out.

name: Brouwersdam
notes: Shallow, flat inshore water at low tide on the sea side; the Grevelingen side is a tideless saltwater lake. Separate foil-only zone. Also: Ouddorp beach (accesses 7–9, waves and strong ebb current) 3 km south.

name: Neeltje Jans
notes: North Sea side, park at the Roompotsluis. Flat at low tide, chop at high tide; advanced riders.

name: Vrouwenpolder
notes: Veerse Gatdam lagoon, best around high tide. From May a buoyed kite zone applies.

name: Kamperland – Roompot
notes: Oosterschelde: long shallow flat water for N–E winds. Stay out of the channel; oyster shells.

name: Domburg
notes: Wave spot by the Westkapelse Zeedijk, experts only; pole rows submerged at high tide. Keep clear of bathing beaches in summer.

name: Cadzand-Bad – Zwin
notes: West of Cadzand-Bad, park at the Zwin visitor centre. Deep water. Also: Vlamingpolder (advanced) just east.

name: Oostvoorne
notes: Shallow, beginner-friendly beach. The Oostvoornse Meer (flat-water lake, launch on its north shore) is 1.5 km away. Also: Rockanje Sportstrand (2nd slag) 3 km south; Maasvlakte – Slufter 6 km north (advanced, partly October–April).

name: Hoek van Holland
notes: North of the pier, by the Hoekse Watersport Vereniging. Strong currents, not for beginners.

name: Zandmotor
notes: Sand engine with a shallow lagoon, good for learning. Extra restrictions 15 May–15 Sep. Also: Kijkduin just north (surf, currents, submerged groynes).

name: Scheveningen
notes: Noorderstrand zone north of groyne 42 (lighthouse); waves, currents, busy. Quieter Zwarte Pad (KZVS club) 2 km north.

name: Noordwijk
notes: Kite zone north of the boulevard; advanced riders. Also: Katwijk 4 km south (deep water, advanced).

name: Zandvoort
notes: 15 Apr–1 Oct launch only in the six watersport zones (e.g. The Spot); no restrictions the rest of the year. Also: Bloemendaal aan Zee 3 km north (advanced, currents).

name: IJmuiden
notes: Kennemerstrand south of the pier: flat water in the bay. Zone 2 only October–March.

name: Wijk aan Zee
notes: Zones by the Bunker/HangOut and the north pier.

name: Camperduin
notes: Small lagoon at low tide, waves outside. Also: Petten 3 km north (Hondsbossche dunes, currents).

name: Texel – Paal 17
notes: Kite zones between poles 17.6 and 19 (De Koog). Waves and currents. Also: Paal 28–32 by De Cocksdorp; Wadden side at Dijkmanshuizen (April–September, high tide).

name: Muiderberg
notes: IJmeer, shallow fresh water; beginner-friendly. Also: Almere – Muiderzand across the IJmeer (deep water, advanced).

name: Schellinkhout
notes: Markermeer, shallow and flat; beginner-friendly.

name: Strand Horst
notes: Wolderwijd, shallow flat water; beginner-friendly. Also: Elburg on the Veluwemeer (April–September).

name: Workum (IJsselmeer)
notes: Shallow fresh water, beginner-friendly. Also: Hindeloopen 5 km north (deep water close in).

name: Makkum (IJsselmeer)
notes: Shallow. Kiting allowed October–April only.

name: Stavoren
notes: It Suderstrand, deep water; advanced riders.

name: Lauwersoog
notes: Wadden side: shallow, around high tide, all year. Lauwersmeer side June–September only.

name: Terschelling – Noordzee
notes: North Sea beach (Midsland aan Zee). Also: Groene Strand near West-Terschelling (shallow flat water, beginner-friendly).

name: Ameland – Noordzee
notes: 1 Mar–1 Nov only between poles 8.2–11.3 (Nes/Ballum), 17.4–19 (Buren) and 3–4 (Hollum). Also: Wadden side by the Nes ferry pier (3 h either side of high tide).
